summary: A batch of six defects found by an automated code-review pass on the classes_detail PR (mvanhorn/printing-press-library#1774), independent of the live-account verification rounds and the Greptile rounds already covered by full-sync-offset-persists-after-success.json. (1) mergeClassesListItemWithStoredDetail (internal/store/peloton.go) used a comma-ok map lookup on "ride" to decide whether a classes record was already detail-shaped; a literal JSON `"ride": null` (which the API can return) satisfied the comma-ok check and was wrongly treated as detail-shaped, discarding real detail data on the next merge. Replaced with classFactHasRideObject, which unmarshals the value and requires a non-nil object. (2) The MCP context tool's field-shape tip (internal/mcp/tools.go) claimed every offline command wraps its result under a "result" key; that's only true for offline_workout (detail/history nesting) -- every other offline command's fields, including "caveats", sit at the top level. Tip text corrected. (3) doctor's credentials_location (internal/cli/doctor.go, collectCredentialsLocationReport) treated a bundle-read error identically to "no credentials file exists", reporting "none" either way -- masking a real permissions/corruption problem as an auth setup gap. Now a switch distinguishes err != nil ("unknown (checking persisted bundle failed: ...)") from a genuine absence ("none"). (4) sync's --latest-only help text (internal/cli/sync.go) described the run-scoping behavior as applying uniformly to all dependents; classes_detail is a documented exception (its candidate set is already bounded by workouts.ride_id and by which taken classes still lack segments, not by the full catalog, so --latest-only intentionally leaves it unscoped) -- the help text now carves that out explicitly rather than describing behavior the code doesn't have. (5) classSegmentsMissingCaveat's message (internal/cli/offline.go) told a caller to run `sync --resources classes_detail` without mentioning that classes_detail's fan-out is scoped to classes referenced by already-synced workouts, so running it against an empty local workouts table silently does nothing -- caveat text now states the workouts-first prerequisite. (6) offlineClass/offlineClasses (internal/cli/offline.go) carried a dead middle fallback tier reading a "catalog_classes" provider_payloads family; grepped across internal/ and confirmed discriminatorDispatchers (sync.go) is empty, so no write path has ever targeted that family name in this CLI's history -- removed as genuinely dead code, not a defensive no-op, along with its now-orphaned fixture rows in offline_test.go's seedOfflineFacts.
reason: Requested explicitly as a second, non-Greptile-sourced review pass after five rounds of Greptile findings on the same PR raised a user concern about auto-checker-pleasing regressions -- these six findings are the ones judged worth fixing immediately (a real data-loss bug, two stale/misleading doc strings, one error-swallowing bug, one incomplete caveat, one dead-code removal). Three additional findings from the same pass were deliberately deferred rather than rushed: a classes_detail generic-failure-suppression gap (needs new stateful design, not a quick fix, given the day's demonstrated pattern of narrow fixes trading one bug for another), the --select envelope-fallback 5-key bound (already documented as an accepted tradeoff in PR #1774's own body), and a DB round-trip efficiency note (correctness-neutral).
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test and gofmt all green on the classes_detail branch (PR2). New regression tests: TestUpsertBatchWithFacts_ClassesNullRideFieldTreatedAsListForm (finding 1) and TestDoctorSurfacesBundleCheckErrorDistinctFromNoCredentials (finding 3, writes an oauth-token.json bundle with an overly-permissive 0o644 mode to trigger loadOAuthBundle's permission-check error path and asserts credentials_location reports the check failure rather than "none"). Findings 3, 2, and 6 were also ported to the fix/peloton-auth-and-bounded-sync branch (PR1) since doctor.go, tools.go's context-tool tip, and the dead-code shape are shared with that branch's pre-classes_detail tree (findings 1, 4, and 5 don't apply there -- mergeClassesListItemWithStoredDetail, the --latest-only classes_detail carve-out, and classSegmentsMissingCaveat's workouts-first wording are all classes_detail-exclusive).
